title: NativeScript toolchain requirements
description: Semver ranges of the toolchains a NativeScript runtime or package supports. Published under the `nativescript.requirements` key of package.json. Unknown keys are ignored by consumers so new constraints can ship ahead of tooling support.

compileSdk.description: Android SDK platform (API level) range, e.g. ">=35".

node.description: Node.js range; for packages that also declare engines.node, that field wins.

range.description: A semver range. Toolchain versions with fewer than three parts ("37", "16.4") are coerced before matching.
